title: Batch trackDualProgressMetricsProvider's per-track sequential DB reads (N+1 left un-fixed by sibling F13)
why: Each loop iteration awaits _safeLoadLeavesForTrack (itself up to 4 sequential DAO calls: getScopesByTrack, getScopes x1-2, getActiveTracksForProfile, lines 618-648), then completionPercent (397), getCompletionsByTrackAndProfile (406), getEntriesByTrack (408), getProgramForProfileAndCurriculum (421), and conditionally programCalendarPositionProvider (430-431) — up to 9 sequential DB round-trips per track, none parallelized via Future.wait. A profile with 5 active tracks does ~40-45 sequential awaits to render the Progress-hub/Dashboard per-track section, and this provider re-runs on every completionCommittedProvider tick (line 357, i.e. after every single completion mark). The very same file already fixed this exact N+1 shape for the sibling lifetimeDataProvider under the F13 label (completionsByProfileForLifetimeProvider / priorImportsByProfileProvider, lines 78-138) but the batching was never extended here. Actual latency impact is unmeasured (SUSPECTED) — the un-batched pattern itself is CONFIRMED by static reading.
recommendation: Batch the per-track queries the way F13 batched lifetimeDataProvider's — one profile-wide query per DAO partitioned in memory by trackId — or parallelize the independent per-track work with Future.wait.
acceptance_criteria: trackDualProgressMetricsProvider issues O(1) queries per DAO (or explicitly parallelizes per-track work), not O(tracks) sequential awaits
A ProviderObserver-based test mirroring lifetime_knowledge_screen_test.dart's F13 test asserts each batched provider builds once across N tracks
